correctness.rationale: Cayley-Hamilton gives R4(A)=UI+VA and the positive offdiagonal Gram entry xyV², forcing V=0 for isometries. The +I cubic has one real root and one left conjugate pair; the -I shifted quartic factors into precisely one left conjugate pair and one right pair by a unique cubic root. Full root isolation, nondegeneracy, sign perturbation derivatives and strict continuous-time decay are analytically proved. Exact-rational matrix tests and Decimal root checks are reproducible in verify.py; tests are not substituted for uniqueness proofs.

value.rationale: Fully characterizes pathological exact energy conservation for the canonical simplest noncoercively damped coupled oscillator, distinguishes a spurious frozen trajectory from a spurious period-two orbit, and proves sharply different local frequency-perturbation effects. This structural distinction is useful in interpreting discrete energy-preservation and resonance tests; no assertion of general solver performance or high-dimensional extension is needed.
